connector.name: Sentimatix
connector.registryDescription: Real-time NSE/BSE stock sentiment, news NLP, technical analysis & RAG search via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at sentimatix-mcp.up.railway.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package sentimatix-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rishav0123 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BACKEND_API_URL
env.description: Base URL for the Sentimatix REST API. Defaults to the hosted production instance.

env.name: SENTIMATIX_API_KEY
env.description: Optional API key for authenticated tier access. Leave blank for free tier.
